key_insight: Detonation-spraying parameters can tune the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium-dioxide-based metal–ceramic coatings.
engineering_relevance: The reported relationships can guide process settings to improve coating hydrophobicity while managing surface roughness and thickness.
method: Examine coating surface properties under varied detonation-spraying conditions.
Relate nozzle traverse speed and spray distance to coating characteristics.
Determine process settings that maximize hydrophobicity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships between nozzle traverse speed and roughness/thickness, and parabolic relationships between spray distance and roughness/contact angle, but provides no numerical results.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify parameter ranges or predictive errors, so the equations require validation before use outside the tested conditions.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
